books.title: The Great Gatsby
books.author: F Scott Fitzgerald
books.synopsis: Nick Carraway, a young Midwesterner newly arrived on Long Island, is drawn into the orbit of his mysterious millionaire neighbor Jay Gatsby, whose lavish parties are meant to win back the woman he has loved for years. A portrait of Jazz Age wealth, illusion and the corrosion of the American dream.
